profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Developer @ Ategrity
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
A career in software development was never my intention ...

College changed that. I was hooked when a good friend of mine showed me one of his programming projects from high school.  The fact that one could enter a few lines of text and have the computer run them was fascinating. I knew instantly this is what I wanted to do.

Computer programming blends art with science. Having the technical expertise is paramount, but having a creative and imaginative mind is equally as important.  This approach allows one to think outside the box and look for solutions that may not be so obvious.
Being able to build something that solves a problem is just awesome and very satisfying.  
I like to think of software engineering, and all it's components, as the LEGOs of the digital world.


HOBBIES & ACHIEVEMENTS

-- Photography -- 
Capturing unique, colorful compositions and emulating Old Masters' lighting techniques. 
Skills: unique and creative perspectives.

-- Cooking -- 
Started as a dishwasher at 9 in my father's restaurant, cooking by 11. 
Skills: time management, organization, and prioritization.

-- Firefighter--  
Post-9/11, I volunteered at a local fire department, undergoing intense training such as "The Maze," flashover simulations, search & rescue, and navigating hostile environments blind. 
Skills: confidence, stress management, teamwork, and humbleness.

-- Musician -- 
Inspired by accomplished friends, I took up guitar. Still learning, I enjoy the creative process. 
Skills: perseverance, dedication, attention to detail, and patience.

---

I am a perpetual work-in-progress who loves learning and continually strives for excellence in the important aspects of my life. I believe in hard work, balance, family, and friendships. With the right attitude, all skills are attainable, but it's our underlying drive and personality traits that are key to lasting success.
